text_block_list.text:
Having let first place slip through her
fingers at
the Japanese Derby, Narita
Brian grits her teeth,
swallows her
disappointment, and vows to get
even
stronger.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, Хиши Амадзон has
just won her
second tiara on the Tiara
tour. The two of them
decide to settle
their rivalry at the Arima Kinen
once
both Classic Triple Crown series are

finished.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The challenge spikes Нарита Брайан's
fighting spirit.
Before that match,
however, we have the Kikuka
Sho—the
final race of the Classic Triple Crown!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
